arguments.prompt:
Draw BRAND-NEW native detailed pixel-game animation bodies of ADULT ISAAC CLARKE, original DEAD SPACE (2008), level-3 ENGINEERING RIG. Use the supplied newly generated 2008 identity sheet for the exact same complete enclosed BRONZE/BROWN ribbed engineering armor, heavy gloves/work boots, and fully enclosed helmet with EXACTLY THREE NARROW HORIZONTAL CYAN VISOR BARS. Ordinary adult engineer proportions. Cyan spine health strip is only on the BACK when physically visible. No bare head, no red visor, no later soldier/Arctic/remake armor. The only tool is the COMPACT ORIGINAL INDUSTRIAL PLASMA CUTTER, not a pistol, rifle or shotgun: short thick box-like workshop tool with its physical THREE CUTTING PRONGS, small horizontal cutting head, orange/yellow metal housing and dark grip. Grip it with connected gloved fingers at its rear handle, second glove supports its physical body only when needed. Keep tool consistently compact, no long gun barrel, no conventional gun magazine, no blade or sword. On motion and ledge rows, keep the tool secured at the hip and BOTH HANDS FREE when hanging. Isaac's physical glove/boot/tool-contact motions are original adapted crossover choreography based on his 2008 melee/stomp behavior, not official extracted animation. Guard is only physical bracing and protective forearms; no invented bubble shield, magic energy palm, telekinetic debris, floating object, stasis beam, enemy, opponent, injury, blood, gore or dismemberment. The only brief luminous effect allowed is a compact cyan muzzle flash AT THE CUTTER'S REAL PRONGS when a row explicitly requests a shot. No beam drawn to an absent target. Every attack's fourth pose is genuine relaxed recovery with no flash.

CRITICAL LAYOUT: genuine TRANSPARENT RGBA, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, labels, grid, panel lines or checkerboard paint. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND EIGHT ROWS = 32 SEPARATE FULL-BODY DRAWINGS on one TALL PORTRAIT canvas. Prefer1024x1536 or taller. All8rows equal spacing and all4columns equal spacing. Keep upright body about140-155px tall on a1536px-tall source, with VERY GENEROUS transparent gaps between every body and complete soles below each. Each numbered row is its own4-FRAME chronological animation left-to-right: four DISTINCT articulated physical silhouettes, not one copied, mirrored, recolored, moved or effect-varied pose. One consistent crown-to-sole anatomical size through the whole source; crouching, hanging and prone bodies keep their true shorter projected height and must NEVER be enlarged to fill a row. Complete helmet/hands/boots/tool prongs inside each cell; no crossing into another cell or touching canvas edges. Default side/front three-quarter facing RIGHT. Keep exactly two connected arms, two connected legs, natural wrists/elbows. Specific turn row may genuinely rotate through rear-three-quarter. No extraneous particles. All32bodies must actually be present, including4COMPLETE bodies in ROW8. Draw each state described below as a physical chronological sequence.

ROW1 idle: subtle breathing and four clear small real weight/arm shifts, feet planted, tool safely secured at hip.
ROW2 walk: four alternating walking strides toward RIGHT, hips and arms move naturally, tool secured.
ROW3 run: four physically different running strides RIGHT, opposite knees and arms, complete airborne and contact phases.
ROW4 turn: a REAL physical four-body turnaround: starts facing LEFT, rotates left-rear three-quarter, right-rear three-quarter, ends facing RIGHT. Cyan spine on rear only. Not mirrored duplicates.
ROW5 jumpStart: upright preparation, knees bend, heels rise, actual takeoff; four different body configurations.
ROW6 jumpRise: four real rising airborne configurations, changing hip/knee/arm articulation; no floor.
ROW7 jumpApex: four airborne apex-balance/tuck configurations with genuinely distinct limbs.
ROW8 fall: four descending articulated configurations, knees and boots gradually prepare for landing, complete soles.

FINAL CHECK: exactly32complete native bodies, FOUR columns × EIGHT rows, safe transparent margins around every helmet, fingertip, sole and cutter prong. Keep every cyan visor to exactly three horizontal bands. No duplicate poses.

output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-7246f8cd-965b-4c0f-a5df-2dc4b8f0bca1.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
